policy.fit_cutoff: strictly before ISO Monday of each historical game; residuals use earlier dates only

policy.limits: Fixed, bounded residual-form variant; corrected retrospective archive, known periods, no original availability snapshots. Approximate weekly intervals, no multiplicity correction; no proof of future profit.
